name: lingua-forge/missing-translation-notice
title: Missing Translation Notice
description: Renders a polite notice when the current page is being shown in its source language because no translation exists for the visitor's language. Driven by the Lingua Forge router's LINGUAFORGE_LANG_FALLBACK_ACTIVE signal — emits nothing when a translation exists for the request locale.

messageText.default: This page is shown in its original language because a translation isn't available yet.

attributes.messageText: This page is shown in its original language because a translation isn't available yet.
